name: zclass_find_next_by_type_prefix
description: zClass::FindNextByTypePrefix records the prefix length on a seed call and delegates prefix-filtered iteration to the shared bucket iterator.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this wrapper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass list/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x44f6f0 validates computing strlen(prefixText) only when prefixText is non-null, storing g_zClass_FilterIterPrefixLen, and tailing into zClass_List::IterateBucketFiltered with zClass::FindNextByTypePrefix_Predicate.
The native smoke verifies the seed call returns null, subsequent null calls return matching nodes in bucket order, and iteration ends with null.
